terms.title: PolyGo Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of PolyGo. Please read them carefully before using our services.

warning.title: Important
warning.content: By accessing and using the PolyGo service, you agree to comply with and be bound by these terms. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please refrain from using our service.

items.required: Users must provide accurate and complete information to create an account. Any false information may lead to account suspension.
items.verification: We require email verification to ensure user authenticity and system security.
items.age: The service is intended only for individuals 18 years of age or older, or 13 and older with parental/guardian consent.

items.free: Provides access to basic features, including limited public event rooms and matching by language and interests.
items.plus: Offers premium benefits such as unlimited access to private events, creating events, adding translation credits, and video/voice calls.

items.roomCapacity: The maximum number of participants in event rooms is capped to ensure interaction quality.
items.eventVerification: Users creating events must have a verified profile. PolyGo reserves the right to moderate or delete inappropriate events.
items.entryVerification: Certain events may require additional verification or approval from the organizer to join.
items.callDuration: The duration of random video/voice calls may be limited under the Free Plan.
items.matchingRules: The matching system is based on interests, languages, and interests. Abuse of the matching feature is prohibited.
items.cancellation: Users must notify 24 hours in advance to cancel events they created. Participants must cancel their attendance at least 12 hours before the start time.

items.billingCycle: Plus Plan subscriptions are billed monthly or annually and will automatically renew.
items.balance: Users must maintain a valid balance to access paid services. No refunds are provided for fees already paid.

merit.title: Merit & Penalty System
merit.intro: Merit is a system used to evaluate user contribution, reputation, and compliance on the platform. Merit and XP may be added or deducted based on specific actions.

admin.title: Admin Adjustments
admin.content: Administrators have the authority to assign specific Merit increases or penalties in cases of violations or exceptional contributions.

positive.title: Positive Behaviors
positive.dailyLogin: Daily logins help maintain streaks and reward users with Merit and XP.
positive.createEvent: Creating events or games grants XP rewards.
positive.approvedEvent: Events or games approved by administrators receive additional Merit and XP.
positive.joinEvent: Participating in events according to the rules increases Merit.
positive.friend: Adding friends grants Merit and XP.
positive.review: Giving or receiving reviews, especially 5-star ratings, grants Merit.
positive.game: Completing games grants XP based on accuracy and hint usage.

penalty.title: Violations & Penalties
penalty.cancelEvent: Canceling an event after creation will result in a Merit deduction.
penalty.lateEvent: Events that exceed the allowed start time without beginning will receive a significant Merit penalty.
penalty.noShow: Registering for an event but failing to participate will result in a Merit deduction.
penalty.adminPenalty: Other violations may result in Merit penalties at the administrator’s discretion.

items.contentModeration: PolyGo reserves the right to review, edit, or remove any content deemed inappropriate or in violation of terms.
items.violationReporting: Users are required to immediately report any behavior or content that violates the Terms of Service.
items.activityLogging: We log user activity for security, analysis, and moderation purposes.
items.adminAuthority: PolyGo administrators have the absolute authority to suspend or terminate violating accounts without prior notice.

items.dataCompliance: We comply with data protection regulations in handling your personal information. See the Privacy Policy for details.
items.informationSharing: Personal information is not shared with third parties without your consent, except as required by law.

terms.footerNote: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact us via the <link>Support</link> page.
